store_listing.description: bawei extracts the WeChat Official Account article selected by the user and sends it to user-selected publishing platforms as a draft or review submission. It processes channels serially, preserves structured text and supported images, reports login and platform blockers, and only marks a formal publication successful after an anonymous public-page check.
store_listing.summary_from_package: Cross-post WeChat Official Account articles to multiple platforms—draft or publish—with built-in diagnostics.
